meta.project: GigOrmoc Local Freelance Marketplace & Security Architecture

product_overview: GigOrmoc is a local freelance marketplace for Ormoc City that connects freelancers and clients through gig discovery, proposals, agreements, messaging, and profile management. It also includes onboarding, admin governance, and security-focused account flows such as OTP verification, password recovery, and session controls.
core_goals: Create an account with email verification and complete onboarding to start using the marketplace
Log in securely and recover access through password reset when needed
Browse local gigs, post gigs, and apply to opportunities
Manage agreements through milestones, external payment tracking, and reviews
Exchange real-time messages with other users
Update profile details and switch between freelancer and client modes
Allow administrators to manage users, review verification cases, inspect logs, and handle backups

features.name: Authentication & Account Access
features.description: Users can sign in with email and password, handle incorrect credential attempts, and navigate to account recovery or registration.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit sign in form -> See the main app after successful authentication
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect email or password -> Submit sign in form -> See an error message with remaining attempts
Navigate to /login -> Continue after repeated failed attempts -> See a temporary lockout message and countdown before another sign-in attempt
Navigate to /login -> Open password recovery -> Go to the password reset flow
Navigate to /login -> Open registration -> Go to the sign up flow

features.name: User Registration and Email Verification
features.description: New users create an account in two steps, verify their email with a 6-digit code, and then continue into onboarding.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup-step1 -> Enter name, email, and password -> Continue to the next step
Navigate to /signup-step1 -> Enter a taken username or email -> See validation feedback and correct the entry
Navigate to /signup-step2 -> Enter phone number, birth date, and barangay details -> Submit registration -> See the email verification waiting state
Navigate to /confirm-email -> Enter the 6-digit verification code -> Submit code -> See confirmation of verified email and continue onboarding
Navigate to /confirm-email -> Open the in-app mail inbox -> View the received verification code -> Use the code to complete verification

features.name: Password Recovery
features.description: Users who cannot access their account can request a password reset, verify a code, and set a new password.
user_flows: Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter username or email -> Request a reset code -> Open the in-app mail inbox and view the code
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter the reset code -> Submit a new password -> See confirmation that the password was changed
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Enter an invalid reset code -> See code mismatch feedback and try again

features.name: Onboarding and Role Setup
features.description: After verification, users choose how they will use the app, add profile details, and finish setup.
user_flows: Navigate to /step1-mode -> Choose Find Work or Hire -> Continue to the next onboarding step
Navigate to /step2-skills -> Select skills or hiring interests -> Continue to profile setup
Navigate to /step3-profile -> Enter bio and barangay details -> Finish onboarding -> See the main dashboard
Navigate through onboarding -> Review entered profile details -> Confirm completion and enter the app

features.name: Gig Marketplace Browsing and Search
features.description: Authenticated users can browse gigs, search by keywords, and filter opportunities before opening a listing.
user_flows: Navigate to /gigs -> Scroll through gig listings -> Open a gig to view more details
Navigate to /gigs -> Enter a search term -> Review the filtered results
Navigate to /gigs -> Select category filters -> Compare gig cards across the results list
Navigate to /gigs -> Open a gig detail view -> Review budget, description, and client information

features.name: Post a Gig
features.description: Clients can create a new gig listing by entering the job details, budget, and required skills.
user_flows: Navigate to /gigs/post -> Enter gig title and description -> Set the budget and pricing model -> Select category and required skills -> Publish the gig
Navigate to /gigs/post -> Leave required fields incomplete -> See validation feedback and correct the form before publishing

features.name: Gig Detail and Application Workflow
features.description: Freelancers can review a gig in detail and submit a proposal, while clients can review applicants for their own gigs.
user_flows: Navigate to a gig detail screen from /gigs -> Review the gig details -> Proceed to the application flow
Navigate to a gig application flow -> Enter proposal details and rate -> Submit the application -> See the submission confirmed
Navigate to a gig applicants view from a gig the user owns -> Review applicant proposals -> Open a candidate profile or conversation -> Accept a proposal
Navigate to a gig application flow -> Enter invalid proposal details -> See validation feedback and correct the submission

features.name: Agreements, Milestones, and Payment Tracking
features.description: Once a proposal is accepted, users manage contract milestones, review work, record external payments, and track agreement progress to completion.
user_flows: Navigate to an agreement from activity or gig-related views -> Review milestones and payment status -> Continue to milestone management
Navigate to milestone setup -> Enter milestone amounts and details -> Submit milestones -> See the agreement updated with the milestone plan
Navigate to a milestone review flow -> Review submitted work -> Approve the milestone or request a revision
Navigate to payment reporting -> Enter external payment details -> Submit the payment record -> See the payment reflected in the agreement
Navigate to payment dispute flow -> Review a reported payment -> Submit a dispute reason -> See the payment marked as disputed
Navigate to a completed agreement -> Open the review flow -> Submit a star rating and comment -> See the review saved

features.name: Real-time Messaging
features.description: Users can open conversations, exchange messages in real time, and follow ongoing discussions tied to gigs or agreements.
user_flows: Navigate to /messages -> Select a conversation -> Open the chat view
Navigate within a chat conversation -> Type a message -> Send the message -> See it appear in the thread
Navigate within a chat conversation -> Observe incoming messages -> Continue the discussion in real time

features.name: Notifications and Activity Tracking
features.description: Users can review proposals, contracts, milestone status, payments, and system alerts from activity and notification views.
user_flows: Navigate to /activity -> Review recent proposals, contracts, and milestone updates -> Open a relevant item for more detail
Navigate to the notifications screen -> Review unread alerts -> Open a linked destination from the notification
Navigate to /activity -> Observe payment or agreement status changes -> Continue to the related workflow

features.name: Profile Management and Public Profiles
features.description: Users can view and edit their own profile, manage skills and portfolio items, and view public profiles of other users.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Review profile details, ratings, and settings access -> Open profile editing
Navigate to profile editing -> Update bio or location details -> Save changes -> See the updated profile
Navigate to skills management -> Add or adjust skills -> Save the skill list -> Return to the profile
Navigate to portfolio management -> Add a portfolio item -> Save it -> See it listed on the profile
Navigate to a public profile view -> Review public skills, ratings, and portfolio -> Return to the previous screen

features.name: Role Switching and Session Settings
features.description: Users can change their active work mode, update passwords and email addresses, and inspect active sessions.
user_flows: Navigate to role settings -> Review eligibility for switching modes -> Change active mode -> See the new mode take effect
Navigate to password settings -> Enter current password -> Enter a compliant new password -> Save the change -> See confirmation
Navigate to email settings -> Enter current password and a new email address -> Request a code -> Verify the code -> See the email updated
Navigate to sessions settings -> Review active sessions -> Revoke one session or revoke other sessions -> See the session list refresh
Navigate to sessions settings -> Trigger the idle timer test control -> Observe the inactivity warning flow and auto-logout behavior

features.name: Administrative Governance
features.description: Administrators can view dashboards, manage users, inspect verification items, review audit logs, and manage backups.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> Review platform metrics and shortcuts -> Open a management area
Navigate to /admin/users -> Search or filter users -> Open a user record -> Update account status or lock state
Navigate to /admin/verification -> Review queued verification cases -> Inspect the legitimacy details -> Approve, request changes, or reject the case
Navigate to /admin/log-trail -> Search the audit history -> Review an event entry -> Return to the dashboard
Navigate to /admin/backups -> Review available backups -> Create a new backup -> Restore a selected backup after confirmation -> See the backup state updated

routes.description: Welcome landing screen with options to log in or register
User login screen with email, password, and lockout protection
Initial registration step for email and basic credentials
Second registration step for personal details and barangay location
Password recovery and reset request screen
OTP verification screen for email verification
Email confirmation waiting screen
User role/mode selection between Find Work and Hire
Skills selection for freelancers
Profile bio and setup completion
Main dashboard displaying available gigs, active agreements, and recommendations
Gig search and filter marketplace screen
User activity, proposals, contracts, and milestone tracking
Chat inbox listing ongoing client-freelancer conversations
Current user profile view with skills, ratings, and settings access
Post a new gig with title, description, budget, and category
Detailed view of a specific gig listing
Apply to a specific gig listing
Real-time messaging conversation view between two users
Administrative overview dashboard with platform metrics and quick actions
Administrative user management list
Administrative identity verification queue
Administrative audit and activity log trail

View error alert on invalid credentials
Navigate to Forgot Password or Sign Up

Enter phone number, birth date, and select Ormoc barangay

features.name: Gig Marketplace Browsing & Search

user_interactions: Tap on a gig card to open details

user_interactions: Set budget amount and pricing model

user_interactions: Select a conversation from messages list

user_interactions: View profile details and rating score
Switch active role between Find Work and Hire
